subject: SPEC-036: Memory Injection Rules UI Components
description:
Build frontend UI components for memory injection rule management in customer and admin consoles, enabling users to create, edit, and manage injection rules.

**Requirements:**
- Rule creation form with trigger type, strategy, and priority selection
- Rule list view with filtering and sorting
- Rule editor for updating existing rules
- Rule activation/deactivation toggle
- Rule performance visualization

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Users can create new injection rules through UI
- Rule list displays all user rules with status
- Rule editor allows updating rule properties
- Rules can be activated/deactivated via toggle
- Performance metrics are displayed for each rule

**Dependencies:**
- Backend API endpoints (already implemented)
- Frontend shared components

subject: SPEC-036: Injection Analytics Dashboard UI
description:
Implement analytics dashboard UI component showing memory injection performance metrics, rule effectiveness, and user feedback visualization.

**Requirements:**
- Dashboard showing total injections, success rate, and trends
- Rule performance comparison view
- User feedback visualization
- Injection timeline chart
- Top performing rules list

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Dashboard displays comprehensive injection analytics
- Charts show trends over time
- Rule performance is comparable side-by-side
- User feedback data is visualized clearly
- All metrics are up-to-date and accurate

**Dependencies:**
- Backend analytics API (already implemented)
- Frontend charting library

subject: SPEC-036: CLI Commands for Rule Management
description:
Implement CLI commands for memory injection rule management, enabling power users to manage rules from command line.

**Requirements:**
- `mem injection rule create` - Create new injection rule
- `mem injection rule list` - List user's injection rules
- `mem injection rule show <rule_id>` - Show rule details
- `mem injection rule update <rule_id>` - Update rule
- `mem injection rule delete <rule_id>` - Delete rule
- `mem injection rule enable/disable <rule_id>` - Toggle rule status
- `mem injection analytics` - Show injection analytics

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- All CLI commands work correctly
- Commands provide clear output
- Error handling is comprehensive
- Commands support JSON output format
- Help documentation is complete

**Dependencies:**
- Backend API endpoints (already implemented)
- CLI infrastructure

subject: SPEC-036: Memory Injection Rules Test Suite
description:
Create comprehensive test suite for SPEC-036 features including unit tests, integration tests, and E2E tests for rule management and injection operations.

**Requirements:**
- Unit tests for rule engine and evaluation logic
- Integration tests for API endpoints
- E2E tests for rule creation and injection workflows
- Performance tests for rule evaluation
- Edge case testing (conflicting rules, invalid triggers, etc.)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Test coverage >90% for injection rule code
- All integration tests pass
- E2E tests cover critical workflows
- Performance tests validate rule evaluation speed
- Edge cases are handled correctly

**Dependencies:**
- All SPEC-036 implementation (backend complete)
- Test infrastructure

subject: SPEC-036: Rule Validation and Error Handling
description:
Enhance rule validation logic and error handling for memory injection rules, ensuring robust rule creation and execution.

**Requirements:**
- Comprehensive validation for rule conditions
- Validation for trigger type and strategy combinations
- Error messages for invalid rule configurations
- Rule conflict detection
- Graceful handling of rule execution failures

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Invalid rules are rejected with clear error messages
- Rule conflicts are detected and reported
- Rule execution failures are logged appropriately
- Users receive helpful feedback on rule issues
- System remains stable with invalid rules

**Dependencies:**
- Rule engine (already implemented)
- Validation logic enhancement needed
